title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Welcome Home

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane that was once ordinary but is now a single hungry House, born from a summoning, a binding and a contract, that devours those who enter.

entities.name: The Boilerbilge
entities.description: A hot part of the House where the narrator has claimed a dining room.

entities.name: The Demon of Duskmourn
entities.description: A being too great to be controlled that was bound in an ordinary house; it accepted a contract, was freed to feed, and grew into the House itself.

entities.name: The Narrator
entities.description: An unnamed survivor of Duskmourn who keeps a dining room in the Boilerbilge and coaxes guests to sit and stay so the House will leave them be.

events.summary: The narrator greets new arrivals in the parlor and invites them to sit, promising only a moment's rest.
events.quote: You're safe here, for the moment.

events.summary: The narrator explains that Duskmourn is both the world and the House.
events.quote: The House is the world, the world is the House, and the word for both is Duskmourn

events.summary: Flashback: the people of the plane, discontent with scarce magic, learned to summon hungry creatures from the void.
events.quote: The people of what became Duskmourn learned the art of summoning creatures from the lifeless void, beings of hunger and raw strength.

events.summary: Flashback: a creature too great to control was bound in an ordinary house, and someone accepted its contract, freeing it to feed.
events.quote: when it offered them a contract, they accepted. They paid its price, and it was finally free to feed.

events.summary: The House swallows the rest of the world until only Duskmourn and survivors in its walls remain.
events.quote: The House was a bloated corpse swallowing the rest of the world

events.summary: Something changes and the House learns to open new doors in new places, reaching out to feed on other worlds.
events.quote: all at once, the House could open new doors, in new places.

events.summary: The narrator reveals the guests are trapped by the chairs they sat in willingly, and that the House will take its first bites of them.
events.quote: if I can convince people not to fight it long enough for it to take the first few bites, it lets me keep my little space

events.summary: The narrator bids farewell, staying behind as the House feeds on the guests.
events.quote: As long as I can keep feeding my dining hall, it won't feel the need to feed on me.

relations.quote: This part of the house is called the Boilerbilge.

relations.note: The bound creature that became the House, feeding on contracts.
Survives in the House by feeding it guests.
relations.quote: I was clever enough to learn how to survive in here
